findings.note: 28 names the newest-printing repoint re-cased. Measured over the whole 384-record repoint set: every name change it produced is letter-identical to the printing it replaced, so all 28 are the Archives' heading style. The rename boundary in overlayContent() stops any future reprint from doing it again; these rows restore the ones already shipped.
